podcast.body: Released for Christmas 2003 and retailed by November 18, this live album and DVD was recorded during a performance at Reliant Stadium in Houston on August 2, 2003. While the audio is entirely from the Houston show, the video footage was shot both in Houston and the following night in Dallas, leading to visible continuity changes in band members' appearances. "All the video we see was shot in Houston and the next night in Dallas. The audio though is just from Houston."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This concert album was released in 2003. It was designed to buy the band some time amidst intense recording sessions, remixes, DVDs, and world tours, providing fans with new material while the band managed their demanding schedule. "Lincoln Park from their 2003 concert album Live in Texas."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
